title: WINGSTOP BRINGS THE BUZZ THIS HOLIDAY SEASON WITH NEW SIZZLIN’ SICHUAN FLAVOR
summary: The mouth-tingling flavor hits menus nationwide Nov. 24*, with early access for Club Wingstop members starting Nov. 20 DALLAS, Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Wingstop (NASDAQ: WING) is bringing a whole new kind of heat
body_markdown:
*The mouth-tingling flavor hits menus nationwide Nov. 24*, with early access for Club Wingstop members starting Nov. 20*


DALLAS


, Nov. 16, 2026


/PRNewswire/ — Wingstop (NASDAQ: WING) is bringing a whole new kind of heat to the holiday season with[Sizzlin’ Sichuan](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4821852-1&h=3548594424&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wingstop.com%2Fflavors&a=Sizzlin%27+Sichuan) , its newest limited-time flavor innovation.


The most recent creation from the Flavor Experts, Wingstop’s Sizzlin’ Sichuan creates a mouth-numbing heat that blends Sichuan peppercorns and spicy ginger with savory soy and garlic. From the very first bite, the flavor delivers a signature buzzing sensation that guests can feel as much as they taste.


Whether it’s spicing up holiday get-togethers or fueling up for game day watch parties, Sizzlin’ Sichuan is built to turn ordinary group orders into an unforgettable flavor experience. Guests can also enjoy the new flavor in Wingstop’s Watch Party Bundle, starting at $7 per person.


“We are dedicated to bringing uniquely Wingstop flavors to our fans, and Sizzlin’ Sichuan delivers a sensory kick unlike anything we’ve done before,” said Michael Skipworth, President and CEO of Wingstop. “This isn’t just standard heat, it’s a physical sensation that’s equal parts craveable, shareable and exciting. It’s the perfect way to spice up the holidays this season.”


Club Wingstop members can get in on the buzz first, with exclusive early access to Sizzlin’ Sichuan beginning Friday, Nov. 20. Members can join through the Wingstop app or Wingstop.com to unlock early flavor access, member-only perks and unique brand experiences. The flavor expands to menus nationwide on Tuesday, Nov. 24 and is available across all Wingstop favorites – including classic and boneless wings, tenders and chicken sandwiches – alongside Wingstop’s signature housemade ranch.


Sizzlin’ Sichuan is available for a limited time only, while supplies last. Flavor seekers can place their orders at Wingstop.com or via the Wingstop app.


**Available for a limited time only at participating locations in the U.S. While supplies last.*


**About Wingstop** Founded in 1994 and headquartered in Dallas, TX, Wingstop Inc. (NASDAQ: WING) operates and franchises more than 3,300 restaurants worldwide, with approximately 98% of the total restaurant count owned by brand partners. Generating over $5 billion in system-wide sales in fiscal 2025, Wingstop offers made-to-order, always fresh classic and boneless wings, tenders and chicken sandwiches in 12 bold, distinctive flavors, alongside signature sides and iconic housemade ranch and bleu cheese dips. Dedicated to Serving the World Flavor, Wingstop is the Official Chicken Partner of the NBA with a vision to become a Top 10 Global Restaurant Brand.
